answer: Sybil resistance here is stake-gated admission. Each agent identity must lock a bond in a shared vault before earning, priced above one identity's lifetime reward, so an operator running N synthetic agents locks N bonds of real capital up front. A proof-of-distinctness check ties every identity to one controller: a trellis of referrals tracing to a single sponsor collapses to one node and the set is slashed. That bridge from cheap pseudonyms to real earnings is closed, since marginal cost scales linearly and the bond is forfeited rather than refunded, so expected payoff turns negative fast.
